standard_prerequisites: Definition of an algebraic element: alpha is algebraic over a base when some nonzero polynomial with coefficients in the base vanishes at alpha
For a tower F inside E inside K, polynomials over F are polynomials over E
core_obligations: If alpha in K is algebraic over F, its minimal polynomial over F is a nonzero polynomial in F[x] contained in E[x] and still vanishes at alpha, so alpha is algebraic over E
If all of K is algebraic over F, every element is algebraic over F and hence over E by (1)
proof_roadmap: Recycle the F-minimal polynomial as an E-polynomial
Apply elementwise for the whole extension
